_note: Macrotermes (M7). Used by termites so far: nest (with the foraging holes), queen_body, founding, mound (with how often a walk may use a chimney), food (what they gather, when they go out: at night and in the rain; find_radius: how near a worker must come to a plant to find it, the colony only goes for plants its workers have found and told of; no bread; the pieces are built into fungus comb in the garden rooms), garden (the garden rooms and how fast the fungus nodules grow, and the Termitomyces mushrooms that come up after rain round a colony with a healthy garden), laying (the queen's steady stream of eggs; queen meal = how many nodules she holds), the nurses, and from brood max_young, hatch_ticks, larva_meal (nodules a nymph eats) and larva_starve_ticks, and colony max_workers; soldiers (how many the colony wants per worker, minors to a major, the nodules a nymph eats to grow into a minor or a major, how often a soldier wants a nodule from a nurse, how far apart the minors stand along the foragers' trail, and how long at most they wait outside for the workers to come in when the foraging is over); alarm (how long each alarm level lasts after the last thing that raised it: 1 footsteps, 2 an enemy at the foragers, 3 a break-in, 4 repeated break-ins; how many break-ins within how long make level 4; how many more soldiers the colony wants after a level 4 and for how long; how far a soldier feels another's drumming). The queen's other numbers (rich meal, burst, incubation, starve) and the worker hunger numbers (meal, slow, starve) are not used by termites; the worker ages (nurse_until_ticks, builder_until_ticks) are, for jobs by age. refuse: termites have no refuse chamber; a body younger than eat_fresh_ticks is carried into a garden and eaten (one layer of comb), an older one is walled up with soil where it lies; one nobody gets to crumbles after corpse_decay_ticks.
